Est. 1979

More than a golf club. We're family.

LaFleur Golf Club has been family-owned and operated since 1979. For over four decades, we've welcomed golfers and diners to a place where regulars aren't just customers — they're part of the family. Set on a challenging championship course in Kahnawake, LaFleur is a community gathering place where the fairways are well-maintained, the prime rib is unforgettable, and the Long Island Iced Teas are — by all accounts — better than Long Island's.

The Course

A Course That Humbles You. In the Best Way.

LaFleur is a full-length 18-hole championship course — not the short par-3s you'll find elsewhere in the region. Narrow fairways demand accuracy, and well-maintained greens reward precision. Plan for 4.5 hours to do it right. No tee time required — we operate first come, first served (though course access may be restricted on tournament dates).

Course Legend

Millie's Tree

On the front nine — believed to be hole 6 — stands the most famous hazard on the course: Millie's Tree. Named after the original owner's grandmother, this towering landmark sits squarely in the line of play. Golfers have been targeting it for decades. It wins more often than they do.

LaFleur's Dining Room

Fine food. No fuss. No tax.

The dining room is open Thursday through Sunday, 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM. Chef Arnold brings his signature touch to every plate — from perfectly prepared prime rib to daily chef's specials. And if you haven't tried our Long Island Iced Tea, you haven't had a Long Island Iced Tea.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything You Need to Know

⛳ Golf Course

Do you have a driving range?

No, we do not have a driving range.

Do I need to book a tee time?

No tee time required — we operate on a first come, first served basis. Please note that course access may be restricted on tournament dates.

Is there a dress code?

Yes, proper golf attire is required for all players.

Do I need to bring my own equipment?

Yes, all golfers must bring their own bag and clubs. Caddies and ride-alongs are not permitted.

Is there a minimum age to play?

Golfers must be at least 12 years old and must be accompanied by an adult.

How long should a round take?

All 18-hole rounds must be completed within 4.5 hours. Please be respectful of pace and our course marshals.

Can I bring my own alcohol onto the course?

All alcohol must be purchased on site. Outside alcohol is not permitted.

What payment does the snack bar accept?

The snack bar is cash only. An ATM is available on site.

Is there tax on food?

No — there is no tax on food at LaFleur Golf Club.

How do I book a tournament?

Call our main line and press 3 to speak with someone about tournament bookings.

🍽️ Dining Room

What are the dining room hours?

The dining room is open Thursday through Sunday, 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM.

Do I need a reservation?

Reservations are strongly encouraged. We occasionally close for private events, so calling ahead ensures your table is waiting.

Is gratuity included?

An automatic 18% gratuity is added for parties of 8 or more.

What payment methods are accepted?

We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and cash.

Is there tax on my meal?

No — there is no tax on food at LaFleur Golf Club.

Are high chairs available?

Yes — high chairs are available for the 2026 season.
